symbols.description: Stock symbol or supported index filter. Accepts one value, a comma-separated string, or a list. Supported index aliases (available: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, SENSEX) are expanded to constituent company symbols.
symbols.title: Symbols

scrip_codes.description: Scrip-code filter. Accepts one scrip code, a comma-separated string, or a list of scrip codes.
scrip_codes.title: Scrip Codes

from.description: Inclusive range start (ISO-8601). Date-only values such as 2026-05-02 use start of day Asia/Kolkata (IST). Prefer lookback_days for relative windows (e.g. last 7 days). Use from/to only when an explicit calendar range is required. Do not combine lookback_days with from or to.
from.title: From

to.description: Inclusive range end (ISO-8601). Date-only values such as 2026-05-02 use end of day Asia/Kolkata (IST). Prefer lookback_days for relative windows (e.g. last 7 days). Use from/to only when an explicit calendar range is required. Do not combine lookback_days with from or to.
to.title: To

detailed.description: When true, include richer fields (long_summary, related_categories, descriptor, earnings_significant, etc.). Completed category extractions (`extracted_information`) and earnings tables (`earnings_table`) are included by default even when detailed is false. Announcements can omit extractions with include_extracted_information=false; extraction strings are capped for response size.
detailed.title: Detailed

categories.description: Announcement category filter. Accepts one category, a comma-separated string, or a list of categories. Use get_announcement_categories to get the list of categories.
categories.title: Categories

include_extracted_information.description: Include completed category extractions. Strings are capped at 2,000 chars; detailed single-id fetches allow 20,000.
include_extracted_information.title: Include Extracted Information

ids.description: Optional record id filter from a prior list or search result (`id` field). Accepts one id, a comma-separated string, or a list of ids (max 20). When set, fetches those records directly and ignores symbol, scrip, date, and pagination filters.
ids.title: Ids

lookback_days.description: Relative day window ending now (UTC), inclusive. Prefer lookback_days for relative windows (e.g. last 7 days). Use from/to only when an explicit calendar range is required. Do not combine lookback_days with from or to.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
